STATE OF NEW YORK
        ________________________________________________________________________

                                          9943

                    IN SENATE

                                     April 16, 2026
                                       ___________

        Introduced  by  Sen.  GRIFFO -- read twice and ordered printed, and when
          printed to be committed to the Committee on Local Government

        AN ACT in relation to authorizing the village of New Berlin to  alienate
          and discontinue the use of certain parklands

          {+The  People of the State of New York, represented in Senate and Assem-+}
        {+bly, do enact as follows:+}

     1    Section 1. Subject to the provisions of this act, the village  of  New
     2  Berlin  is  hereby authorized, acting by and through its governing body,
     3  and upon such terms and conditions as determined by such governing body,
     4  to discontinue the use as parkland and alienate the lands  described  in
     5  section  three  of  this  act, and to sell and convey such lands at fair
     6  market value to  Good  Shepherd  Communities  for  the  purpose  of  the
     7  construction of a skilled nursing and rehabilitation facility.
     8    § 2. The authorization contained in section one of this act shall only
     9  be  effective  on the condition that the village of New Berlin dedicates
    10  an amount equal to or greater than the fair market value  of  the  park-
    11  lands being discontinued towards the acquisition of new parklands and/or
    12  capital  improvements  to existing parklands and recreational facilities
    13  within the village of New Berlin.
    14    § 3. The parklands authorized by section one of this act to be discon-
    15  tinued as parkland is described as follows:
    16    All that certain piece, parcel,  or  tract  of  land  situate  in  the
    17  Village  of New Berlin, Town of New Berlin, County of Chenango, State of
    18  New York being more particularly bounded and described as follows:
    19    A. Beginning at a capped iron rod set at the intersection of the divi-
    20  sion lines between the lands now or formerly conveyed to the Village  of
    21  New  Berlin as recorded in the Chenango County Clerk's Office as Instru-
    22  ment No. 2004-00000434 on the  southeast,  the  lands  now  or  formerly
    23  conveyed to Blue Chip Enterprises Inc. as recorded in the Chenango Coun-
    24  ty  Clerk's Office as Instrument No. 2012-00001710 on the northeast, and
    25  the lands now or formerly conveyed to Melvin W. Stewart as  recorded  in
    26  the  Chenango  County  Clerk's Office as Instrument No. 2012-00001710 on
    27  the west;

     1    B. Thence running along division  line  between  the  Village  of  New
     2  Berlin  on  the  south  and  Blue Chip Enterprises Inc. on the north and
     3  extending the said division line through the lands of the Village of New
     4  Berlin, N88°39'33"E a distance of 485.51 to a capped iron rod set on the
     5  approximate westerly edge of an existing gravel driveway (2026);
     6    C.  Thence running through the lands now or formerly of the Village of
     7  New Berlin along the following five (5) courses and distances  generally
     8  along the westerly of an existing gravel driveway (2026):
     9    1. S28°04'27"E a distance of 55.20 feet to a point;
    10    2. S48°12'52"E a distance of 90.12 feet to a point;
    11    3. S65°36'47"E a distance of 173.51 feet to a point;
    12    4. S45°22'11"E a distance of 72.65 feet to a capped iron rod set;
    13    5.  S05°32'46"E a distance of 178.19 feet to an iron rod found marking
    14  the southeasterly corner of the property to be conveyed and in the divi-
    15  sion line between the Village of New Berlin (Instr.  No.  2004-00000434)
    16  on  the  north  and the lands now or formerly conveyed to the Village of
    17  New Berlin as recorded in the Chenango County Clerk's  Office  in  Liber
    18  562, Page 262 on the south;
    19    D.  Thence  running along the division line between the Village of New
    20  Berlin (Instr. No. 2004-00000434) on the north and the  Village  of  New
    21  Berlin  (Liber  562,  Pg.  262)  on the south, N88°38'20"W a distance of
    22  115.58 feet set an iron rod found;
    23    E. Thence running along the  division  line  between  Village  of  New
    24  Berlin  (Instr.  No.  2004-00000434) on the north and the Village of New
    25  Berlin (Liber 562, Pg. 262), the lands now or formerly conveyed  to  the
    26  Village  of New Berlin as recorded in the Chenango County Clerk's Office
    27  as Instrument No. 2021-00001792 and the lands now or  formerly  conveyed
    28  to Andrew C. Orzeck as recorded in the Chenango County Clerk's Office as
    29  Instrument  No.  2003-00002379  on  the south, S83°29'38"W a distance of
    30  799.75 feet to an iron pipe found marking the southwest  corner  of  the
    31  property to be conveyed;
    32    F.  Thence running the division line between the Village of New Berlin
    33  (Instr. No. 2004-00000434) on the east and Andrew C. Orzeck on the west,
    34  N13°53'08"E a distance of 404.70 feet to an iron rod found  marking  the
    35  intersection  of  the  division  lines between the Village of New Berlin
    36  (Instr. No. 2004-00000434) on the east, Andrew C. Orzeck on  the  south-
    37  west and the aforementioned lands of Melvin W. Stewart on the northwest;
    38    G.  Thence  running along the division line between the Village of New
    39  Berlin (Instr. No. 2004-00000434) on the east and Melvin W.  Stewart  on
    40  the  west,  N04°39'33"E  a distance of 92.74 feet to the point of begin-
    41  ning.
    42    § 4. In the event that the village of New Berlin received any  funding
    43  support  or  assistance  from  the  federal government for the purchase,
    44  maintenance, or improvement of the parklands set forth in section  three
    45  of this act, the discontinuance and alienation of such parklands author-
    46  ized  by the provisions of this act shall not occur until the village of
    47  New Berlin has complied with any federal requirements pertaining to  the
    48  alienation  or  conversion of parklands, including satisfying the secre-
    49  tary of the interior that the alienation or conversion complies with all
    50  conditions which the secretary of the interior deems necessary to assure
    51  the substitution of other lands shall be equivalent in fair market value
    52  and usefulness to the lands being alienated or converted.
    53    § 5. This act shall take effect immediately.
